title: Landmark is nested
user_impact: Screen reader users who jump via landmark navigation land in an unexpected context.
technical_impact: <header>/<footer>/<main> or role="banner"/"contentinfo"/"main" is a descendant of another landmark.
source: WAI-ARIA 1.2 banner, contentinfo and main roles (should not be contained in another landmark); axe landmark-*-is-top-level
applicability: Rendered banner, contentinfo and main landmarks.
expectation:
Flags a banner, contentinfo or main landmark nested inside another landmark,
at the nested one. A header or footer inside main or article is no banner or
contentinfo at all and is not flagged. Best practice without a criterion.
